desc:
🚧Inspired by "La Subasta Futbolera" from Program 412🚧
✌️Highly recommended to play with friends, it's super fun!🤣

Soccer Auction is all about bidding on players who appear randomly from a pool of 400+ players! But you have to guess who you're bidding on just by their silhouette... will it be a superstar or a troll player?

At the end of the match, the winner is decided in a tournament where teams face off position by position. Whoever wins the most positions wins the Football Auction!

👍Leave a Like & Favorite⭐
